svg.text: appvol — proposed UI (mockup)
orange numbers = notes below; app icons are placeholders
Profiles view
Running apps view (replaces the «Cycle the running applications» toggle)

g.text: Idle profiles return to Active after 5 min ⓘ
Idle profiles return to Active after 5 min ⓘ

svg.text: Mode switch Profiles / Running apps instead of the toggle
«Cycle the running applications». Two clear views.
⋮ menu takes the settings: «Show app name in OSD»,
Bind Keys…, About. Header and footer get lighter.
«Active window» is pinned above the list, always visible.
The Step setting lives only here (global).
The list sits in its own area with a scrollbar; header, Active
card and footer never scroll; the window can shrink.
One line per item: radio · icon · name + caption · slider ·
% · mute · ⋮. Long names are ellipsized with …
Current key target: accent bar on the left and a light row
tint (the radio button stays for selecting).
Edit / Delete / Step / Bind Keys move into the row ⋮ menu.
Caption shows the key: «1 stream · Meta+F9» or «no key · Bind…».
Empty state: a dashed «New profile» row instead of a blank
screen; the toolbar button does the same.
One-line footer; the long text about keys and the 5-minute
idle return goes into the ⓘ tooltip.
Narrow window (< 480 px): the slider wraps to a second line
under the name; minimum width 360 px; no horizontal scroll.
⋮ menu (open)
